—Qin Shujian disappeared from Cheng An’s world. When Cheng An realized this fact, it was already five days after the college entrance examination. He searched like crazy for two days and two nights, and finally understood that she was gone. Qin Shujian left. Don't want him anymore. His little simplicity, don't let him go. ...The last English test of the college entrance examination ends at 5 pm. Cheng An took out his mobile phone from the locker outside the classroom and turned it on, and saw the message from his father Cheng Tongyi. The cousin's aunt who settled in the UK passed away. Cheng Tongyi's company was too busy these days to take time to attend the funeral. He was not willing to let his beloved wife travel so far alone, so this task fell decisively on Cheng An, who was about to finish the college entrance examination. The driver was already waiting at the school gate. The flight was at 7 o'clock in the evening. Cheng An should contact the driver immediately after the exam. Cheng An's face turned green when he saw the news. It took nearly an hour to get from their school to the airport. It was already 5:10, so he had to get to the airport at least half an hour early. So now there is less than 20 minutes left for him. He originally thought that he could finally take Xiao Jian to the hotel tonight, but now this plan was completely ruined. Just at this time, the driver's phone also came in. Cheng An took the phone, said a few words, and hung up in a hurry. Then he walked a few steps quickly, grabbed Qin Shujian's hand who had just reached the classroom door, and ran quickly towards the back of the teaching building. Qin Shujian was frightened and dragged by him for five minutes, and then he pushed him against a tree in the grove. Both of them were panting slightly. Before Qin Shujian could ask him what he was doing, he clasped the back of her head with one hand and lowered his head to cover her lips. Cheng An kissed her for a long time before letting her go, holding her in his arms, gently brushing her earlobe with his lips and asking, "Did you miss me?" Since the night of his birthday, for more than a month, whenever he had the chance to be alone, he couldn't help but want to hug her and kiss her. He had booked a hotel for tonight... Thinking of this, Cheng An's breathing became heavy. He kissed her earlobe, chin, tip of nose, and finally touched the corners of her eyes with his lips. Then he found Qin Shujian looking at him blankly, as if he was stupid. He raised the corners of his lower lips and couldn't help but let out a shallow laugh from his throat, "Little fool, did you fail the exam?" Qin, Little fool, wrote a letter, blushing suddenly. She moved her lips and was about to say something, but when she thought about what she was determined to leave, the heat on her face gradually cooled down, and for some reason, she suddenly felt a little sad. She lowered her eyes and responded in a low voice, "Yeah." Cheng An touched the corner of his lips between her eyebrows, then used a hand to pinch her face, and said with a chuckle: "It doesn't matter if you don't do well in the exam, I did well in the exam." I will support you from now on. Qin Shujian blinked slightly, not understanding what his success in the exam had to do with her, but she didn't have the time to think about it now. After today, she is no longer his little maid. They have no relationship anymore. But it was obviously something she wanted, but at this moment, she somehow found it difficult to breathe, her heart throbbed, and the tip of her nose was slightly sore. Cheng An saw that the corners of her eyes suddenly turned red, thinking that this little fool probably really failed the exam and was so sad. He wanted to comfort her, but there was no time, so he could only kiss her again and said warmly, "I have to go out for two or three days for something. Let's meet at the coffee shop near your home at 2 o'clock today, Tuesday and Saturday, okay?" Qin Shujian subconsciously wanted to say, "Okay." ", but somehow she couldn't say the deceptive words at this time. She looked at the young man in front of her, who was obviously very afraid of her, but there was an inexplicable fire burning in her heart, which made her heart burn hot. For the first time, she impulsively raised her head and kissed his lips awkwardly.
